title: Asahina Mafuyu — A Somewhat Different Dinner Table〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Hope Will Someday Go Beyond the Morning

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Okay, Mafuyu, I'll be going now.
Please watch over the house for me while I'm gone.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. You should be able to really focus on studying since you don't have club activities today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I should be able to do all my homework and go over what we did during cram school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: That's my daughter. But don't study too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thanks, Mom.
I'll make sure to take breaks here and there.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What was I assigned for homework? Math and English...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Why is my computer still on...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that's right... I was close to finishing my lyrics but decided to stop since I needed to go to sleep.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But there's really only a little bit left to do... I think I'll finish working on my lyrics since I might not be able to focus while studying if I leave them unfinished...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hm? Hey, Yuki!
Fancy seeing you here at this time. Do you not have club or cram school today?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Amia... Yes, both are off today, so I decided to work for a bit.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, sorry, I meant...!
It really is rare seeing you here at this time.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<So, wanna work together...?
Let's see... Based on the current time...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But it's 11:37, so shouldn't you round up to 11:40?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, Yuki, there's something I noticed about you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah! We've been meeting each other in real life more and more lately, but you're the only one who's been going over to everyone's houses.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And if you come over to my house, Yuki, you'll complete the N25 set.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hm? You don't seem all that interested... I'm really curious as to what everyone's rooms are like.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Because a person's room says a lot about who they are, right? I really like seeing and hearing about stuff like that!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. For example, Enanan's room was pretty messy, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Same with K. She mentioned that she needs to clean her room more, but they're pretty similar, aren't they?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<No, they aren't...
Enanan's room was the furthest thing from organized, but it wasn't as cluttered as K's room.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, that's what I'm talking about!
There's a clear difference between them!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Heehee. My room's immaculate!
I'm careful about where things go and always put things back where they belong!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Including my clothes.
I make sure to put them back in my closet instead of throwing them on the floor.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes, I had a feeling that your room is very tidy...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<See what I mean?
By the way, Yuki, what about your room?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<My room...?
It has a desk, a bed, a chest of drawers and a fish tank...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I remember you mentioning that you're using it to grow seagrass or aquatic plants.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<There're tons of species, right?
What do you have in there right now?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Why am I talking about this right now...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I need to finish working on my lyrics so that I can study...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And yet, this conversation... It's like I want to just...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Whoa, you're right...!
Sorry, Yuki. I didn't mean to ask you so many questions.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I know that I have a lot of things to do, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Me too♪
Anyway, let's get back to work!>
